sourceContract.sectionals: edgeiq_form_sectional_profile_feed_v1.csv joined by runner+run date+track+race number+distance; CLASS_BENCHMARK preferred over ALL_CLASSES_BENCHMARK.

sourceContract.pricing: edgeiq_fair_price_v7_2.csv selected only on exact current race date/track/race/runner; when V7.2 rows are stale, exact current governed live-board fair_price is used with governed V3 provenance; no historical or market fallback.

sourceContract.raceShape: edgeiq_current_race_shape_v2.json runner-specific current race-shape adapter; unsupported runners are not defaulted to MIDFIELD.
sourceContract.suitability: edgeiq_current_suitability_v1.json current-race runner-specific setup score; not a duplicate of EPI.
sourceContract.lateSpeed: edgeiq_current_late_speed_v1.json current-race projection from as-of benchmarked late sectionals where available, with speed_master late_raw fallback; late_power_index remains blocked.
sourceContract.formMomentum: edgeiq_current_form_momentum_v1.json point-in-time trajectory score from as-of historical EPI/sectional/margin evidence; not finish-position-only.
